additional_info.subject: Handover notes
additional_info.body:
Problem 1: Gap dimensions
Dispensers have incorrect gap dimensions causing door closure
issues. Gap widens at top, preventing door contact switch
activation - sometimes requiring slamming. Rewe offered
replacement, but all factory dispensers have this defect. Videos
available on request.
Problem 2: Cable lugs mismatch
Supplied cable lugs (240mm²/185mm²) have M10 holes, but
copper rails only have M8 screws (not included). SiD Gen1 leftover
screws are M10, creating compatibility issues.
Problem 3: Cable bracket interference
Supply cable brackets (A+, B+) provided with 4 threads per side,
but cables don't fit adjacent on ERK dispenser. Even using lower
fasteners prevents filter replacement during maintenance.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0447443-DC/Si-D/AT-[Multiple]Multiple Errors CRM:02698000497
additional_info.body:
Dear Laurenz,
I am reaching out as Technical Expert for Sicharge D in regards of ticket
ID0447443.
Thank you for raising the ticket and highlighting these quality issues during commissioning.
I discussed the three topics with Sicharge D product Champion and got the following inputs from Product Care:
In regards of point 1 (closing issue on dispenser's door), Product Champion informed me that the topic was already raised to Product Care in the past weeks, and Product Care provided already a statement to Johannes Dissauer, clarifying that there is no quality issue on the closing mechanism of the dispenser door, and provided visual instructions on how to properly close the door.
From Product Care, I got to know that unfortunately t
he electrical connection of Dispenser and Sicharge D main unit has always been problematic, and there has been several changes in development and early production, not all of which are reflected in product documentation yet.
The change in mounting material dimensions is one of the production changes that was not reflected in product documentation. There are Dispensers with M8 size holes in the copper while the published product documentation still states nuts and screws shall be fixed with 40 Nm torque (which would apply for M10). What the documentation states is  to bring M10 cable lugs (which are not shipped together with the dispenser), but the Dispenser connection point have M8 holes.
Therefore, please use M8 size mounting material and fix it with 20 Nm of torque.
I raised the awareness in Product Care about the wrong documentation, hoping to speed up the process of publishing new and correct documentation.
Could you please provide photos and further explanation of what is the impediment created by fitting the cables adjacent in the ERK dispenser connection, and how this affect the filter replacement? In Product Care they have not heard about this physical constraint and impediment before, hence photos will help us to better understand the issue and possibly take corrective measures.
Many thanks in advance for your feedback.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon!
With kind regards,
